exposure: preterm delivery/neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 100 matched pairs of postpartum women who delivered at a large, integrated urban medical system in Bronx, New York, in 2012-2013
finding: Delivery-related complications, delivery timing (weekend delivery), and certain sociodemographic factors (primiparity, public insurance) were identified as risk factors for increased postpartum emergency department utilization.
mod_finding: Following conditional logistic regression, delivery mode on the weekend [30% vs. 26%, aOR 7.61, 95% CI 1.15-52.43] was associated with an increased risk of postpartum emergency department use.
